faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Common questions about our legal services and practice areas

items.question: What legal services are included in YAR Law Firm representation?
items.answer: We handle commercial litigation, corporate crime matters, employment disputes, business activity assistance, construction matters, state administrative disputes, and bankruptcy/PKPU proceedings. Our service scope is tailored to each client's needs, whether corporate or individual.

items.question: Can I request an initial consultation before appointing legal counsel?
items.answer: Yes. You can begin with an initial consultation to map legal issues, risks, and strategic options. After that, we will recommend next steps, including the proposed scope of representation and an estimated timeline.

items.question: What documents should I prepare for the first consultation?
items.answer: Helpful documents include a short chronology, relevant contracts or agreements, correspondence, transaction records, and any official documents related to your issue. Our team will provide a more specific checklist after the initial assessment.

items.question: How long does a legal matter usually take to resolve?
items.answer: The duration depends on the matter type, factual complexity, and dispute forum (negotiation, mediation, arbitration, or litigation). At the beginning of engagement, we prepare a working timeline so expectations remain clear.

items.question: Does YAR Law Firm represent both corporate and individual clients?
items.answer: Yes. We represent both corporate and individual clients, including SMEs, national companies, and public entities. Our approach is adapted to each client's business profile, legal objective, and urgency level.
